Version history

Review Savely updates by version and importance.
v2.8.47MINOR
  • Click the live weather badge to open the Zoom Earth satellite viewer.
  • Viewer tries to center on the selected weather city and includes a full-site fallback.
v2.8.48MINOR
  • Replaced the blocked Zoom Earth iframe with an embedded Esri World Imagery satellite map.
  • Centers the map on the saved weather city when geocoding is available; Zoom Earth remains available in a separate tab for weather overlays.
v2.8.45MAJOR
  • Set email confirmation redirects to the Savely GitHub Pages project URL.
  • Enabled real Supabase email/password sign-up and login instead of local testing-mode access.
  • New accounts are created in Supabase Auth; authenticated sessions are used for account-scoped savings sync.
v2.8.40MINOR
  • Reorganized Version History into a side-by-side two-column layout for easier comparison of major and minor releases.
  • Updated the startup popup to show only the newest patch updates instead of repeating previous release notes.
v2.8.40v2.8.38MINOR
  • Added a warning confirmation before changing date, time, or timezone.
  • Added a confirmation dialog before logging out.
v2.8.37MINOR
  • Restyled Sort by and placed it beside Overall History and Export list.
  • Improved responsive layout for narrow screens.
v2.8.36MAJOR
  • Added Savings sorting by amount and institution type.
  • Added a View savings graph control to expand the graph.
  • Removed the extra monthly/yearly interest estimate description under the rate.
  • Updated the startup updates popup with major and minor labels.
  • Added version history in Settings.
v2.8.35MINOR

Removed zoom behavior from candle endpoint clicks while preserving bank history selection.

v2.8.34MINOR

Moved the graph timestamp to the right-most endpoint and refreshed the updates popup.

SAVELY UPDATES

What’s new in Savely

Version 2.8.68 · Latest patch

MINOR UPDATE · v2.8.68
  • Refined email OTP authentication flow for sign-up and login.
  • Requests Supabase email OTP through the Auth OTP endpoint and verifies the entered code.
  • Verified accounts use Supabase Authentication sessions for account-scoped cloud sync.
  • Updated account and privacy messaging to explain authentication and cloud data setup.
  • Added an embedded satellite map that opens from the live weather badge, with Zoom Earth available for weather layers.
  • Fixed the selected-bank savings graph height so it stays compact and fits inside the Savings panel.
  • Satellite map uses Esri World Imagery and centers on the selected weather city when available; Zoom Earth opens separately for weather layers.

MariBank interest

Savings account · estimated earnings
Rates verified from MariBank’s official fees and rates page. 3.25% p.a. applies to the first ₱1,000,000; 3.75% p.a. applies to the portion above ₱1,000,000. Daily interest is based on the previous day’s ending balance and subject to 20% withholding tax. Estimates assume the balance stays unchanged and use 365 days.
